description: Self-reconfigure that ENABLES addon-ssl + addon-oidc on the running Hub. Pre-state: Hub on HTTP without OIDC. Pipeline: Hub clones itself → temp clone runs reconfigure (with selectedAddons) against the source Hub → new CT replaces old Hub → new CT boots with OIDC_ENABLED=true + SSL cert mountpoint. Post-state: Hub serves HTTPS, /api/* requires OIDC. Runner-side Stage-G machine-token kicks in: after Zitadel install the executor reads DEPLOYER_OIDC_MACHINE_* from oidc_default stack and uses them for the bundle pull against the now-OIDC-protected new CT.
